content.text:
I submitted **index 12 (Sb fraction 0.45)**. It gave the highest measured EQE, 0.325%. I used all 5 EQE measurements and 3 of the 5 XRD measurements.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | 0.27 | 0.116 |
| **12** | **0.45** | **0.325** |
| 13 | 0.48 | 0.291 |
| 19 | 0.66 | 0.017 |
| 25 | 0.80 | 0.018 |

- **Trend:** EQE rises from Sb 0.27 to a peak near 0.45 and dips a little at 0.48. From about 0.66 upward it drops to almost nothing.
- **XRD:** Samples at Sb 0.35, 0.45 and 0.55 all show the same rutile-type pattern. At 0.55 extra peaks appear, meaning a second phase is starting. So index 12 sits inside the single-phase range, below where that second phase appears.

**Main uncertainty:** I didn't measure EQE between Sb 0.27 and 0.45 (indices 7–11). The Gaussian-process model's top suggestion for the last measurement was index 10 (Sb 0.375), but I chose index 13 instead. So a composition in that gap could be slightly better than index 12. Index 13 (0.48) came in lower, so the peak is not on the Sb-richer side.
